description: The municipality of Bari publishes technical, operational and geographic descriptions of its public-lighting infrastructure. The metadata identifies supports, electrical cabinets, foundations, meters, luminaires and other components. It states that the inventory includes materials, power, consumption, position and operating condition to support management, maintenance and optimisation of the lighting system. Six CSV resources correspond to the listed component categories. These asset attributes can inform lighting-system optimisation; the inspected metadata does not establish network connectivity, a consumption sampling interval or engineering-model parameters. Coverage is the municipality of Bari, Italy, at individual-component level, with no stated positional accuracy or coordinate reference system. Metadata was modified on 27 January 2025; the asset observation period is unspecified. Creative Commons Attribution is stated without a version. Cost and download access conditions remain unverified. The public metadata page was checked and no data files were downloaded. A separate municipal MUSICA publication reports lighting consumption. It is retained as an operational view of the same city lighting service, with distinct native package and distribution identities. Its units, observation period, aggregation level and links to individual meters remain unknown.
